reference_v2_publications.scope: New-study forecasts of frozen published v2 weights under the v3 runtime; not recovered original v2 evidence or a completed v2 decision.

scope: Complete source/data/weights/raw publication and runtime bindings; all current and frozen-v2 reforecast rows plus archived v1 grounded rows, dimensions, normalization and views. All ten saved language extensions contain exactly unchanged parent88 plus four learned coordinates and no extra saved weights. Full mode also checks every fresh/opened decision gate, critical world/action summaries, every fresh/opened point metric, all goal and retention records. Canonical opened regressions are gated; masked regressions and ambiguous actual-world changes are descriptive. All four TRAIN artifacts remain identical. Current v3 parser/text-only controls are collected on every challenge bank. No cross-runtime bit reproduction is required. Archived v1 keeps its original runtime; frozen-v2 reforecasts use the v3 runtime. Saved conditional targets are validated but not regenerated. ECE, omitted rich summaries, timing and memory costs are not independently recomputed. Lexical receipts and deterministic registry assignments are checked without invoking the tokenizer. Publication is verified in local git objects, not remote custody.
